annotations.title: Record the decision on a prediction

description: Record what a person decided on an item judge predicted, once they decided. A different verdict with a reason becomes a judgment. Unconfirmed until a person confirms it.

by.description: The id of the expert who decided

criteria.description: Tags the reason relies on, e.g. no-source

domain.description: The domain, when the prediction has none

prediction_id.description: The whole prediction_id a judge call returned

reason.description: The person's reason, exactly as they gave it; never reworded

verdict.description: The verdict the person chose, one of the prediction verdicts

name: resolve_prediction
title: Record the decision on a prediction
